source.name: Gruvbox
source.note: accent shifts canonical blue #83a598 (hue 157) to #7fb0b5 (hue 186) so tailnet sits inside the cool 180-290 degree band and stays distinct from the computer blue; media shifts canonical purple #d3869b (hue 344) to #b986d3 (hue 280) for the same cool band; muted uses fg3 #bdae93 instead of fg4 #a89984 for 4.5:1 text contrast. The light variant keeps the canonical gruvbox light ramp and needs no contrast shifts. Media uses #7a4a9e, a darker stand-in for canonical purple #8f3f71, and iot uses #2f6f5a, a darker aqua, so phone/media and computer/iot stay distinct on the light canvas.

source.name: Nord
source.note: muted uses #a7b1c2, lightened from nord3 #4c566a for 4.5:1 text contrast; history and device use #8a96ab, lightened from nord3 for 3:1 canvas contrast; media shifts nord15 #b48ead (hue 311) to #a18eb4 (hue 270) so the category sits inside the cool 180-290 degree band; canvasBottom is #242933, nord0 darkened because Nord defines no darker base. The light variant is a Hearthlight-authored pairing derived from the Snow Storm ramp: bg #eceff4 (nord6), canvasBottom blends nord5 #e5e9f0 with nord4 #d8dee9, and ink is Polar Night #2e3440. Aurora and frost marks are darkened at the same hue for 3:1 graphics contrast: green #a3be8c to #4c7a2a, yellow #ebcb8b to #8a6a1f, orange #d08770 to #a35a3d, purple #b48ead to #8a5f86, frost teal #8fbcbb to #2f736f, and #81a1c1 to #3f6f8f. Media uses #6f5a8a and history #5f6b7d for low-chroma separation; accent keeps nord10 #5e81ac.
